actions.title: Show protection status
actions.summary: Reports which protections are active, unverified or unsupported.

actions.title: Check for Aether updates
actions.summary: Verifies signed update metadata and lists pending packages. Installs nothing.

actions.title: Show the concurrent install queue
actions.summary: Prints the last install receipt: what was installed, failed or blocked.

actions.title: Show firewall status
actions.summary: Lists the default-deny policy and any ports opened on purpose.

actions.title: Install an application
actions.summary: Installs one Flatpak application for this account. Requires an enabled remote.

actions.title: Turn off on-device AI
actions.summary: Stops Nimbrel for every account on this device until it is enabled again.

actions.title: Enable on-device AI
actions.summary: Allows Nimbrel to start on demand when opened. No model is downloaded.

actions.title: Run the encrypted backup
actions.summary: Runs the configured local encrypted backup. Success is not a restore test.

actions.title: Check for firmware updates
actions.summary: Refreshes signed firmware metadata and lists available updates. Flashes nothing.

actions.title: Trust a connection as Home
actions.summary: Applies home-scoped firewall exceptions only while that saved connection is active.
